name: skill-family-docs
description: Methodology skills for public documentation sites: planning, writing style guard, UI design, and rendering with skill-family-doc-render

interface.shortDescription: Plan, write, design, and render public documentation sites
interface.longDescription: Six platform-neutral skills: skill-family-docs-help entry, skill-family-docs-render-site (site information architecture plus the skill-family-doc-render CLI workflow), skill-family-docs-style-guard (three-gate Chinese technical writing guard with a self-contained Node checker), skill-family-docs-site-design (public docs site UI guide), skill-family-docs-setup (read-only readiness checks plus bounded local wiring when explicitly requested), and skill-family-docs-quickstart (intent routing only). Generic methodology only; no private paths or business data.
